title: Goa Beach Escape
shortDescription: Four sun-soaked days split between North Goa's buzz and South Goa's calm — beach resort stay, a sunset cruise on the Mandovi and the best of the coast.
description: The perfect long weekend. You'll stay at a beachside resort a short walk from the sand, with easy days built around the best of both coasts: Fort Aguada and the lively beaches of the north, then the quiet coves and palm groves of the south.

Evenings are for sundowners at a beach shack and a golden-hour cruise on the Mandovi river, with live Goan music on deck. Plenty of free time is built in — because in Goa, the plan is often no plan at all.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa — beach time
itinerary.description: Private transfer from the airport to your beach resort. Check in, change into something light and head straight to the sand. In the evening, catch the sunset with a drink at a beach shack.

itinerary.title: North Goa forts & beaches
itinerary.description: Explore 17th-century Fort Aguada and its lighthouse, then hop between Candolim, Calangute, Baga and Anjuna. End the day with a sunset cruise on the Mandovi river, complete with Goan folk music and dancing.

itinerary.title: South Goa's quiet coast
itinerary.description: Drive south to the cliff-top ruins of Cabo de Rama and the crescent of Palolem Beach. Swim, kayak or simply lie back under a palm before heading back north.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: A last swim or a lazy breakfast before your transfer to the airport.

inclusions: 3 nights at a 4-star beach resort on twin sharing
North and South Goa sightseeing by private AC car
knowBeforeYouGo: Swimming is restricted on many beaches during the monsoon (June–September)
Carry sunscreen and stay hydrated — the sun is strong even in winter
